method: At exact shared POSITION tuples across the explicitly listed region patches only, replace participating normals by the normalized unweighted mean of one unit normal per named part. No proximity tolerance. Skip within-part split normals and near-opposed vectors. All other data remains byte-identical.
protected: Bladder trigone/orifice/neck meshes fully untouched; spleen hilum fully untouched. No position, index, boundary, opening, source name, transform, tangent, UV or material changes. Tangents remain source values and are unused because no normal-map texture exists.
interpretation: Reversible display-shading derivative, not corrected source anatomy. No smoothing, fill state change, hole fill, reconstructed tissue, registration, clinical or runtime validation.
approval: unreviewed R03 shading trial; root must inspect exact-export pixels
